title: digitaria commutata subsp. nodosa
intro: Digitaria commutata subsp. nodosa, commonly known as Finger Grass, is a type of grass found in tropical and subtropical regions. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Digitaria commutata subsp. nodosa include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and treat wounds. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified in its leaves and stems.
